purpose: Proves the tests in slrc-p2-postgres-evidence.json can fail: each store/manager invariant was broken in turn and the wrapper re-run against a fresh card-owned postgres:16-alpine container. Mutated files were restored from HEAD after every run (git show HEAD:<path> > <path>); none of them is modified by this card.

mutants.mutation: claim_due availability predicate `AND (claim_owner IS NULL OR claim_expires_at <= $1)` replaced by `AND TRUE`
survived_in: test_two_actual_connections_collide_on_one_claim (pre-existing: two connections under SKIP LOCKED do not expose a missing availability predicate)

mutants.mutation: _finish_claim runs its UPDATE and outbox INSERT without connection.transaction()
_execute_teardown_claim no longer skips stages already in teardown_stages_completed

harness_defect_found_by_mutation: Under M1 the first throughput worker loop never terminated (claim_due re-granted held claims forever). The loop is now bounded at rows+1 claims so a broken store fails instead of hanging.

wrapper_gates.injection: synthetic junit with one skipped case

merge_preview_with_p2_1.method: git archive of 5cdbc8da into /tmp; this card's appended test block concatenated after P2-1's version of the integration file; wrapper run unchanged. No worktree or ref was modified.
merge_preview_with_p2_1.expected_merge_conflict: both cards append to the end of test_environment_lifecycle_store_integration.py; resolve by keeping P2-1's block then P2-2's block

container_hygiene: every run used label slrc-card=P2-2 on 127.0.0.1 with an ephemeral port and a random password; `docker ps -aq --filter label=slrc-card=P2-2` returned 0 after each run. Foreign containers sldp-p41-pg and anvil-p41-pg were not touched.
